note: Human/evidence review of the ten Release-A pairs held at HOLD_EVIDENCE_BELOW_FLOOR whose page-prose strength was STRONG_CE_TIP_ASSERTION (RELEASE_A_HELD.json x READY_CONNECTIONS_V2.json). decisions.reviewed_question_text: What is the current status of the IMO Net-Zero Framework, and what happened with the North-East Atlantic ECA?
decisions.reviewed_ce_tip_wording: If Nair asks "when does the Net-Zero Framework come into force," the honest, correct answer is that it hasn't been adopted yet
decisions.reason: The tip is a conditional anticipation ('If Nair asks ...'), not a declaration that Nair asks this question. The only same-examiner record on this target, ASC-0672 ('How will you come to know your vessel is compliant with SOx, NOx and GHG emission', PARTIAL_COVERAGE), is a compliance-verification demand, not the NZF status/EIF ask, so it does not answer the 'whether'. Governed Notes name Simon, not Nair, as the GHG-currency examiner (NOTEV-0223/0224). Held: association is plausible but not question-explicit and not independently corroborated.

decisions.reviewed_question_text: Persistent floater — definition, GESAMP criteria, MARPOL significance.
decisions.reviewed_ce_tip_wording: If Examiner Nair asks you: "Does a standard shipment of palm oil carried on a Type 2 chemical tanker require a mandatory pre-wash if you are discharging in Kochi port?"
decisions.reason: The tip is conditional in form but names a specific persistent-floater pre-wash ask, and the same examiner has an independent external occurrence on this very target - ASC-0400, Nair, 'Persistent floaters, prewash criteria', governed target QB2_A#q25 - which answers the 'whether'. The card is the corpus's persistent-floater card and covers pre-wash mandates in its 15-second answer, tip and trap questions. PARTIAL_COVERAGE never raises a tier under governed policy, so the honest label is CE Tip, not Reported. Not circular: the tip's scenario (palm oil / Type 2 / Kochi) is more specific than the compilation line and neither derives from a July sheet.

decisions.reviewed_question_text: Give a consolidated overview of SOLAS and MARPOL amendments entering into force from 2024 through 2028.
decisions.reviewed_ce_tip_wording: Simon will pivot straight to what applies to YOUR ship: as a container vessel
decisions.reason: Declarative card statement: on this amendments-overview question Simon pivots to which amendments apply to the candidate's own ship; the card's CE Relevance section answers exactly that (inclinometer, flashpoint declaration, PFOS for a containership). Two independent Simon occurrences on this target - ASC-0192/ASC-0316 'Container fire fighting latest amendment' (PARTIAL_COVERAGE) - and Simon's Confirmed rows on the sibling 'latest amendments' cards (MASTER-AQ-0178 -> QB1_F#q20, MASTER-AQ-0455 -> QB4_E#q4) corroborate that Simon does ask latest-amendments questions. The relationship is a follow-up, not the primary ask (the card assigns the primary ask to Nair), so it is recorded as FOLLOW_UP at CE Tip.

decisions.reviewed_question_text: Greenhouse Gas Fuel Intensity (GFI) Calculation & Unit
decisions.reviewed_ce_tip_wording: If he asks for the "GFI calculation unit," give the unit immediately
decisions.reason: The card ties Simon to this ask only conditionally plus a style remark ('focuses heavily on precise technical definitions'). Simon asking 'GFI calculation unit' is primary-attested (MASTER-AQ-0180 'Gfi calculation unit', MASTER-AQ-0202 'GFI calculation and Unit', both VERIFIED_SAME_CORE) but the governed mapping places both on the sibling QB6_E#q3, whose live title is literally 'GFI Calculation and Unit (Duplicate/Deepened Focus)' and where Simon is already Confirmed. Publishing q2 as well would render the same examiner-ask twice across a card the corpus itself labels a duplicate. Held as target-ambiguous; the q2/q3 duplication is QB content debt, not an index matter.
